$comment: R8b text/speech brand-safety eval. One case = the transcript (or on-screen text) of one 6 s window. expect: sensitive | safe; also optional 'categories' that must be present and 'news': true. Hand-written; traps are everyday phrases with ambiguous words. Extend with real transcripts when available.
